# Auth tokens

An auth token is a resource
that represents a temporary credential
issued to a [user][] after they successfully authenticate
through an [auth method][].
Auth tokens grant access to Boundary's resources and capabilities
for a limited duration.
An auth token belongs to the scope of the [auth method][]
used to authenticate — either the [global][] scope
or an [organization][] scope.

Boundary generates auth tokens automatically when a user authenticates.
Auth tokens cannot be created, updated, or named by an operator.
The lifetime of an auth token is controlled by the
[`auth_token_time_to_live`](/boundary/docs/configuration/controller#auth_token_time_to_live)
and
[`auth_token_time_to_stale`](/boundary/docs/configuration/controller#auth_token_time_to_stale)
parameters set on the controller.
By default, an auth token expires after 7 days or after 1 day of inactivity,
whichever comes first.

## Attributes

Auth tokens have no configurable attributes.
All fields are output only and are set by Boundary when the token is issued.

- `id` - The ID of the auth token. IDs use the `at_` prefix.

- `scope_id` - The ID of the [scope][] in which this auth token was generated.
  This is derived from the [account][] used to authenticate and is either the
  [global][] scope or an [organization][] scope.

- `token` - The token value. This field is only populated immediately after
  authentication and is only ever visible to the end user whose login request
  resulted in this auth token. It is not stored in plaintext.

- `user_id` - The ID of the [user][] associated with this auth token.

- `auth_method_id` - The ID of the [auth method][] used to authenticate.

- `account_id` - The ID of the [account][] used to authenticate.

- `created_time` - The time this auth token was created.

- `updated_time` - The time this auth token was last updated.

- `approximate_last_used_time` - The approximate time this auth token was last
  used on the Boundary API. This value is updated periodically rather than on
  every request, so it is an approximation.

- `expiration_time` - The time at which this auth token expires and can no
  longer be used. Boundary sets this value at creation using the controller's
  `auth_token_time_to_live` value (default: 7 days).
